raw_blocks: The Baldwin Group to go private. Read a message from our CEO here .
At The Baldwin Group, we translate complex concerns into straightforward, customized solutions to help protect the possible for our clients and enable them to face the future with confidence.​
The right partners for the right moment

The Baldwin Group is going private, in partnership with Sequence Holdings and DFO Management, the family investment office of Dell Technologies Founder, Chairman, and CEO Michael Dell. Our vision is unchanged. Our strategy is unchanged. Our leadership and our culture are unchanged. The only thing changing is the capital structure around the firm, and we are changing it because the moment in front of us demands it.

Every day our clients are pursuing what’s possible, for themselves, their families and their businesses, in a world where risk grows more complex and more connected each year. Our job is to build faster than the risks change. The freedom and the pace this next chapter unlocks will enable us to continue protecting the possibilities our clients are chasing. Read the full message from our CEO .
The Baldwin Group is an award-winning, entrepreneur-led advisory firm delivering insurance, risk mitigation, employee benefits, and wealth management solutions for businesses and individuals. ​

Forget what you know about traditional insurance agencies. At The Baldwin Group, our powered-by-people approach is the bedrock of our culture. The Azimuth is our internal guide to everything we do; it is embedded in our culture and enables us to align our mission, vision, core values, and promises to our stakeholders. We celebrate the diverse insights and perspectives of our colleagues and collaborate openly to deliver optimal solutions for clients.
Discover the endless opportunities that await when you invest in a future with a vibrant and nationally acclaimed organization.

Growth, entrepreneurialism, and continuous learning fuel our success. We collaborate, innovate, and have fun along the way. If you’re ready to challenge yourself and grow, we want to hear from you. Ready to join our team?

Partnering with The Baldwin Group connects you to a network of innovative entrepreneurs focused on transforming the client experience. Together, we’re committed to creating lasting impact and driving success for our partners, clients, and community.

Powered by people starts with an energized and committed group of leaders. From our executive team and board of directors, to our regional leaders and every colleague across the firm – we’re united in our vision to be regarded as the preeminent insurance advisory firm fueled by relationships, powered by people and exemplified by client adoption and loyalty, colleague development and engagement, and operational acumen and evolution.
Every award reflects our commitment to showing up, for our clients and for each other.
